questions.description: The existing plan is already specific; this sets the boundary for the goal package.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Implement the protocol, client send path, server tracking, AppState sync, CWD resolution changes, focused automated tests, and local validation described in PLAN-fix-server-cwd-to-client.md. Keep documentation/release changes out unless validation reveals they are required.

questions.prompt: What verification standard should mark the goal done?
questions.description: Manual server/client behavior is the key external proof for this bug.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Done requires focused automated tests plus just check, and the goal may remain partial if manual fresh-client/server and multi-client validation cannot be completed in-session.

questions.prompt: Should this goal include committing and integrating the change?
questions.description: AGENTS.md requires proposing the commit message before committing and then fast-forwarding the shared checkout when ready.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Plan the implementation through a passing local check and a proposed conventional commit message, but require explicit alignment before committing or pushing.
